# anthropic_rbac_group_members (Data Source)

Lists the members of an RBAC group in a Claude Enterprise organization. Requires `enterprise_api_key`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_rbac_group_members" "engineering" {
  group_id = "rbac_group_01ExampleGroupId00000000"
}

output "engineering_emails" {
  value = data.anthropic_rbac_group_members.engineering.members[*].email
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group id (`rbac_group_...`).

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes List) Members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

### Nested Schema for `members`

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp the user was added.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `user_id` (String) User id.
